sentences.en: The politician tried to cover up the insider trading.
sentences.zh: 这位政客试图掩盖内幕交易。

sentences.en: Suspicion that this amounts to insider trading has strengthened.
sentences.zh: 这可能是内幕交易的怀疑进一步增强。

sentences.en: The hedge fund manager was convicted of insider trading.
sentences.zh: 对冲基金经理因从事内幕交易被判有罪。

senses.zh: 内部的人，会员；熟悉内情者
